description: Production overview for kube-state-metrics. Built for Perses-compatible renderers. Uses only stat, gauge and timeseries panels (no tables / piecharts / transformations). Part of rtifact-alert-rules.

panels.description: Number of nodes currently reporting Ready=true.
panels.title: Nodes ready

panels.description: Percentage of deployments where current available replicas == desired replicas.
panels.title: Deployments healthy

panels.description: Percentage of statefulsets with all desired replicas ready.
panels.title: StatefulSets healthy

panels.description: Percentage of daemonsets with all desired pods ready.
panels.title: DaemonSets healthy

panels.description: Pods broken down by phase over time.
panels.title: Pods by phase

panels.description: Containers waiting (excluding ContainerCreating which is normal) grouped by reason.
panels.title: Containers waiting by reason

panels.description: Top 10 containers by restart rate over the selected window. The legend shows namespace/pod/container.
panels.title: Top 10 container restarts (1h increase)

panels.description: Number of containers whose last termination reason was OOMKilled (observed within the selected window).

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",reason="OOMKilled"}[1h])) == 1) OR vector(0)

panels.title: OOMKilled containers (1h)

panels.description: Containers in CrashLoopBackOff right now.
panels.title: Containers in CrashLoopBackOff

panels.description: Containers stuck in ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull.
panels.title: Containers with ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull

panels.title: Deployments missing replicas

panels.description: Number of daemonsets with fewer ready pods than desired.
panels.title: DaemonSets missing pods

panels.description: Number of deployments + statefulsets where the controller has not yet observed the latest spec generation.

panels.description: Top 10 statefulsets + daemonsets by missing-pod count.
